deals.headline: Sharks extend SAP Center lease through 2050-51 with joint renovation

deals.summary: SSE and the City of San Jose extend the SAP Center lease through the 2050-51 season and jointly invest more than half a billion dollars in the city-owned arena over multiple years. Forbes reports the city contributes up to $350 million of a $425 million renovation.
